title: Tunis Desk – Saturday 17 October 2026
desc: Running order: Civil society coalition including the UGTT marches in Tunis; Two thousand and twenty-seven budget, oil prices and a possible supplementary budget; New nine-member ISIE to be appointed by presidential decree; Appeals court upholds four-year sentence against Khayam Turki; Kais Saied in Bizerte for Evacuation Day; Briefly: hadhaer workers, sugar and flour supply, oil sourcing, regional items; And finally: airport taxi fares.
